plan.title: doctor OpenClaw always-pins: symlink install rejected by OpenClaw symlink-escape

narratives.Description: doctor OpenClaw always-pins: symlink install rejected by OpenClaw symlink-escape
narratives.Overview:
## Summary
`deft doctor --fix` OpenClaw always-pin install (#3001) prefers **symlinks** from `$OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR/workspace/skills/<pin>` → `@deftai/directive-content/skills/<pin>`.

On OpenClaw **2026.7.2-beta.4**, those pins are **not loaded**:

```
[skills] Skipping escaped skill path outside its configured root:
  source=openclaw-workspace
  root=~/.openclaw/workspace-*/skills
  reason=symlink-escape
  resolved=~/.local/lib/node_modules/@deftai/directive/node_modules/@deftai/directive-content/skills/...
```

Doctor still reports **present** (lstat + SKILL.md via symlink resolves), so the host looks healthy while the agent never sees the skills.

## Expected
Always-pins should be **ready** in `openclaw skills list` after `deft doctor --full --fix`.

## Actual
- Disk: symlink present; `deft doctor` ✓
- OpenClaw: skips as `symlink-escape`
- Only non-escaping workspace dirs load (e.g. local `vbrief/`, enterprize thin-attach stub dirs)

## Workaround that works
Replace pin symlinks with **real directory copies** under the workspace skills root (or thin-attach stubs that are real dirs pointing at deposit via absolute path in SKILL.md text — not FS symlinks outside root).

## Suggested fix
1. Prefer **copy** on OpenClaw hosts (detect OpenClaw + known symlink-escape policy), or
2. Attempt symlink then **verify** with a load-policy check / document that OpenClaw requires copy, or
3. Install thin real-dir stubs (SKILL.md only) instead of whole-tree symlink to content package.

## Environment
- OpenClaw 2026.7.2-beta.4
- Directive 0.90.0
- WSL Linux host

Refs: #3001, #2874, #2968
